response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remain, g.avg_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remain / m.mean_avg AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows where proccpu or procgpu is NULL are excluded from the CPU-minus-GPU average only (AVG of the difference ignores NULL differences), while remaingb averages use all rows with non-null remaingb.
A zero mean of group averages would cause a division error/NULL depending on the engine; it is not specially handled.
